title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第六轮：测评优先、日语实景与 GPT-6 Luna
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round six: placement-first onboarding, Japanese scenes, and GPT-6 Luna

purpose.zh: 让新学员先测评再得到课程起点建议，提供日语离线实景对话，并将文字 AI 默认模型升级为 GPT-6 Luna；保留站点专用密钥的条件同步路径。
purpose.en: Recommend a starting course after placement, provide offline Japanese dialogues, and upgrade the default text AI model to GPT-6 Luna while retaining conditional sync for site-owned credentials.

zh: 新用户默认选择十五题定位测评，不需先自报等级；仍可明确选择从基础开始或自行选级别，保存计划不会自动启动 Max 试用。
日语咖啡店和杂货店初级各增加十组任务连贯的店员与学员问答，可在无在线 AI 时加载。
沿用 Konectible 已验证的条件密钥同步；文字 AI 改用 GPT-6 Luna，旧缓存保留审计但不作为新版本内容；语音、图像及审核仍使用专用模型。
en: New learners default to a 15-item placement assessment rather than self-reporting a level; fundamentals and manual level selection remain available, and saving a goal never starts a Max trial.
Add ten coherent beginner staff–learner exchanges each for Japanese cafe and grocery scenarios that load without online AI.

Reuse verified Konectible conditional credential sync. Text AI now uses GPT-6 Luna; legacy caches remain auditable but are not served as new-release content, while speech, image, and moderation retain purpose-built models.

zh: 影响语言规划页、日语初级咖啡店与杂货店、文字 AI 路由、内容缓存及生产发布；价格、支付、既有学习记录和用户资料不变。
en: Affects planning, beginner Japanese cafe and grocery content, text AI routing, content caches, and deployment; prices, checkout, existing learning records, and profiles are unchanged.

zh: 规划页面将起点方式提前，测评路径默认使用免费的初级七日课程承载题目，测评完成后再推荐等级；修复课程列表请求不可达问题。日语新增两组预构建场景；文字 AI 使用 GPT-6 Luna，迁移缓存约束并刷新内容发布时间戳；修复发布报告 SQL 引号测试误报。
en: Move placement ahead of manual courses, restore the joined-course fetch, add two offline Japanese scene sets, and conditionally sync site-owned AI secrets. Set GPT-6 Luna as the text model, migrate cache constraints and release timestamps, and fix the deployment-report SQL-escaping test.

zh: 464 项完整测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint、生产构建与敏感扫描通过；84 项 D1 迁移两次重放，且带旧缓存数据的 GPT-6 Luna 升级测试通过；生产浏览器验收待 CI 发布后执行。
Safari 核对 SmartLingo GitHub Actions 当前没有 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 密钥；密钥同步步骤会跳过，不能据此宣称生产 AI 已恢复。上一推送因发布报告对英文单引号的测试误报停在源码测试阶段，本轮已修复，尚待重新发布。
en: All 464 tests, TypeScript, zero-warning lint, production build, and sensitive scan pass; all 84 D1 migrations replay twice, including a seeded legacy-cache GPT-6 Luna upgrade test. Production-browser acceptance follows CI deployment.

Safari confirms no OpenAI or DeepSeek secrets in SmartLingo GitHub Actions, so conditional sync skips and production AI is not restored. The previous push stopped in source tests on a SQL-apostrophe assertion; this round fixes it and awaits redeployment.

zh: 没有站点专用 AI 密钥时，需 AI 的场景会继续离线兜底；创建可计费新密钥须另行授权并经生产复测。
日语离线覆盖目前仅 2/36 个场景×等级单元，尚未经母语者审校；实时语音和普通付费账号端到端验收未完成。
en: Without a site-owned AI credential, AI-dependent scenarios continue to fall back offline. A new billable credential requires separate authorization and production retesting.
Japanese offline coverage is 2/36 scene–level units and awaits native-speaker review; live voice and ordinary paid-member end-to-end acceptance remain unfinished.

zh: 仅将 Konectible 已验证的可选 AI 密钥同步方式适配 SmartLingo 独立 Cloudflare 流程；日语场景只复用 SmartLingo 既有教学题组结构。
en: Adapt only Konectible's verified optional AI-secret sync to SmartLingo's isolated Cloudflare workflow; Japanese scenes reuse SmartLingo's existing lesson-set structure.

rollback.zh: 本轮重建两个内容缓存表并保留原行；如需回退运行代码，可恢复上一成功提交，但迁移后的数据库约束需保持向前兼容，不要直接删除历史缓存。
rollback.en: This round rebuilds two content-cache tables while preserving rows. Revert application code to the prior successful commit if needed; keep the forward-compatible database constraints and do not delete historical cache rows.
